units.source_text: “一句话，她对你抱有好感，但不能马上答复你。

en.t: In short, she has feelings for you, but she cannot give you an answer right away.

units.source_text: 她在考虑……刚才在电车里，我说咱们三人照张相吧。

en.t: She is thinking it over... Just now on the train, I said that the three of us should take a photograph together.
She said, yes, let us take one.
I thought it was probably all right now.

units.source_text: 算了，一会儿泡在澡堂里再慢慢细谈吧。”

en.t: Never mind, let us soak in the bathhouse later and talk it over properly then.
